# Velox

> Velox compiles Velox Markup (VML) and TypeScript into deterministic MP4 via native canvas render — themes, transitions, captions, and CLI export.

Author product reels with `theme="…"` on `<video>`, scene templates, and semantic blocks. Lint with `velox lint`, render with `velox render`. Markdown copies of every doc page are at `/llms.mdx/docs/…`.

## Start here

- [Overview](/docs): Mental model and minimal VML reel
- [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started): Install, lint, first render
- [VML Prompt](/docs/markup-prompt): System prompt for LLM-authored markup
- [Playground](/docs/playground): Browser preview of VML

## Authoring

- [Themes](/docs/themes): All 51 built-in aesthetics with previews and palette tokens
- [Transitions](/docs/transitions): Scene-to-scene motion types and timing rules
- [Rendering](/docs/rendering): MP4/GIF export, audio mux, quality flags
- [Preview](/docs/preview): Velox Studio hot reload
- [CLI](/docs/cli): `lint`, `render`, `list`, `add`

## Optional

- [GitHub](https://github.com/sanjaymalladi/velox): Source and issues
